correctness.rationale: The backward telegraph equations with bulk Poisson resets have bounded solutions F_-(x)=rf/u+(1-rf/u)e^(-Kx/v), F_+(x)=rf/u+theta(1-rf/u)e^(-Kx/v), where u=r+s, K=sqrt(u(u+2alpha)), theta=alpha/(u+alpha+K). Reset-state self-consistency gives f=u a_k E/(s+r a_k E) with a_- =1, a_+=theta and E=exp(-Kx0/v); the transform of immediate return from the wall is g=theta+(r/u)(1-theta)f. Geometric renewal gives the two terminal-absorption transforms p w f/[1-(1-p)w g] and p w f/[1-(1-p)w f]. All denominators are positive for s>0, so their difference has sign(g-f)=sign(theta-a_k E), with g-f=s(theta-a_k E)/(s+r a_k E). For initial + motion the sign is strictly positive; for initial - write t=arcosh(1+u/alpha), c=alpha x0/v: sign = sign(c sinh t-t). t/sinh t strictly decreases from 1 to 0, proving unique cutoff t_c, reset boundary r_c=alpha(cosh t_c-1) and the s-domain crossing r_c-r iff 0<r<r_c. With finite EW, derivative at s=0 gives mean-time difference (1-p)/(pr)*(1-theta_r/E_r). Independent calculations evaluated the exact renewal fractions and their factorized signs for both initial orientations at four discounts straddling a positive crossing, recovering [-,-,+,+] for the left orientation and all-positive for the right. The result concerns Laplace order, not stochastic dominance or general waiting-time means.
residual_risks: The independent checks cover selected parameters; the unrestricted sign theorem rests on exact factorization and hyperbolic monotonicity.
